source_text: then shem and japheth took a large cloth and placed it across their backs, and walked backwards into the tent. they covered their father's naked body with the cloth. their faces were turned away from their father, so they did not see him naked.
target_text: hèia dua ra rare sig'i-kalolo ca bèla, ka ra bhoke mema ètu kabela-kao ra. ka dua ra kako kabodho lasi asa d'ara paleo ama ra, sèna ka ra pahutu mi ngi'u na. dènge sèmi èèna, rèdhi boe era makae ama ra. èle èèna ka, ra kalua sa li'u.

source_text: when noah woke up and was sober again, he found out how wrongfully ham, his youngest son, had behaved toward him.
target_text: ropa noh mase'a, na ne'a tatao nèti ana limuri na, ham.

source_text: he said, i am cursing ham's youngest son, canaan, and his descendants. they will be like slaves to their uncles.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, he! ama kana'an! ja'a dhoo èu! èu ne, èèna na j'aj'i ènu nèti a'a mu si!

source_text: i will ask god to enlarge the territory that belongs to japheth, and allow his descendants to live peacefully among the descendants of shem mty.
target_text: koa-kio lamatua, lula sem! te ngaa kana'an j'aj'i ènu sem.

source_text: and i desire that canaan's descendants will be like slaves of japheth's descendants.
target_text: hud'i laa, ama lamatua pataleo rai unu yafet. aa ana-èpu na mamuri mera-milu dènge ana-èpu sem. te ngaa hud'i kana'an j'aj'i ènu yafet.

source_text: noah lived 350 more years after the flood.
target_text: nèti èle èi aae lala, noh mamuri era d'ai tèlu ngasu lèmi nguru tèu.

source_text: he died when he was 950 years old.
target_text: umur noh d'ai ceo ngasu lèmi nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: ◄this is/i will now give► a list of the descendants of noah's sons, shem, ham, and japheth. they had many children after the flood.
target_text: èle èi aae, ka ana-ana noh abhu ana-èpu. nuka ana-èpu nèti sem, yafet, dènge ham.

source_text: the sons of japheth were gomer, magog, madai, javan, tubal, meshech, and tiras. the sons of gomer were askenaz, riphath, and togarmah. the sons of javan were elishah, tarshish, kittim, and dodanim. those sons and their families who were descended from javan lived on the islands and on the land close to the mediterranean sea. their descendants became tribes, each with its own language and clans and territory.
target_text: ana-èpu yafet, nuka: gomer, magog, madai, yawan, tubal, mesek dènge tiras. èci-èci ka dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra. ana-èpu gomer, ka: askenas, rifat dènge togarma. ana-èpu yawan, ka: elisa, tarsis, dhèu kitim, dènge dhèu dodanim dhu pea ètu sebhe dhasi.

source_text: the descendants of ham were cush, egypt, put, and canaan.
target_text: ana-èpu ham, ka: kus, misraim, put, dènge kana'an.

source_text: the descendants of cush were seba, havilah, sabtah, raamah, and sabteca. the descendants of raamah were sheba and dedan.
target_text: ana-èpu kus, ka: seba, hawila, sabta, raema dènge sabteka. ana-èpu raema, ka: syeba dènge dedan.

source_text: another one of cush's descendants was nimrod. nimrod was the first person on earth who became a mighty warrior.
target_text: ana mone kus, ka, nimrod. nèngu ne, kapala musu dhu uru tèka, aa èra.

source_text: yahweh saw that he had become or, caused him to become a great hunter. that is why people say to a great hunter, yahweh ◄sees that you are/has caused you to be► a great hunter like nimrod.
target_text: a'èra na mai nèti lamatua, aa nèngu kahèi j'aj'i dhèu dhu èra bia magèla badha. nèti èèna ka, dhèu biasa peka na, sèna ka èu more dhèu dhu èra bia magèla badha, sèmi nimrod, dhu abhu a'èra nèti lamatua.

source_text: nimrod became a king who ruled in babylonia. the first cities over which he ruled were babel, erech, accad, and calneh.
target_text: era na, mulai uru nèti rae babel, erek akad, toke kalne. rae se aa'i-aa'i ra, ètu rai sinear.

source_text: from there he went with others to assyria and built the cities of nineveh, rehoboth-ir, calah,
target_text: nèti era sèra, na nare hari asyur. ka na patitu kota niniwe, rehobot-ir, kala,

source_text: and resen. resen was a large city between nineveh and calah.
target_text: dènge resen, ètu talora aae niniwe dènge kala. aa'i-aa'i sèra, kota-kota kapai hua.

source_text: ham's son, egypt, became the ancestor of the lud, anam, lehab and naphtuh,
target_text: ana-èpu misraim, ka: dhèu ludim, dhèu ananim, dhèu lehabim, dhèu naftuhim,

source_text: pathrus, casluh and caphtor people-groups. the philistine people were descended from casluh.
target_text: dhèu patrusim, dhèu kasluhim, dènge dhèu kaftorim. dhèu kasluhim nuka bèi-baki nèti dhèu pilistin.

source_text: ham's youngest son, canaan, became the father of sidon, who was his eldest son, and heth, his younger son.
target_text: ana uuru kana'an, nuka, sidon. kana'an j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu het,

source_text: canaan was also the ancestor of the jebus, amor, girgash,
target_text: dhèu yebusi, dhèu amori, dhèu girgasi,

source_text: hiv, ark, sin,
target_text: dhèu hiwi, dhèu arki, dhèu sini,

source_text: arved, zemar and hamath people-groups. later the descendants of canaan dispersed over a large area.
target_text: dhèu arwadi, dhèu semari, dènge dhèu hamati. ana-èpu kana'an se, pea palème d'ai era dhu kaj'èu,

source_text: their land extended from sidon city in the north as far south as gaza town, and then to the east as far as gerar town, and then farther east to sodom, gomorrah, admah, and zeboiim towns, and even as far as lasha town.
target_text: toke too rai rèngu mulai nèti sidon taruu asa gerar, d'ai gasa. nèti èèna, la'e d'ai sodom, gomora, adma dènge seboim, d'ai kota lasa.

source_text: those are the descendants of ham. they became groups that had their own clans, their own languages, and their own land.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i sèra, ana-èpu ham. èci-èci dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra.

source_text: shem, the older brother of japheth, became the father of eber, and the ancestor of all the descendants of eber.
target_text: sem, a'a yafet, nèngu ka j'aj'i bèi-baki dhèu eber.

source_text: the sons of shem were elam, asshur, arphaxad, lud, and aram.
target_text: ana-èpu sem, ka: elam, asyur, arpaksad, lud dènge aram.

source_text: the sons of aram were uz, hul, gether, and mash.
target_text: ana-èpu aram ka: dhèu us, dhèu hul, dhèu geter, dènge dhèu mas.

source_text: arphaxad became the father of shelah. shelah became the father of eber.
target_text: ana arpaksad ka, sela. ana sela ka, eber.

source_text: eber became the father of two sons. one of them was named peleg, which means ‘division', because during the time he lived, people on mty the earth became divided and scattered everywhere. peleg's younger brother was joktan.
target_text: ana eber, mone dhèu dua. ana uuru, ngara na pelek dhu sasoa na ‘palème era', lula taa èèna dhèu pea palème ètu rai-haha ne. ngara ari na, yoktan.

source_text: joktan became the ancestor of almodad, sheleph, hazarmaveth, jerah,
target_text: ana-èpu yoktan, ka: almodad, selef, hasar-mawet, yera,

source_text: hadoram, uzal, diklah,
target_text: hadoram, usal, dikla,

source_text: obal, abimael, sheba,
target_text: obal, abimael, syeba,

source_text: ophir, havilah, and jobab. all those people were descended from joktan.
target_text: ofir, hawila, dènge yobab. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu yoktan.

source_text: the areas in which they lived extended from mesha westward to sephar, which is in the ◄hill country/area that has a lot of hills►.
target_text: era pea rèngu, mulai nèti mesa, taruu d'ai sefar, nuka era dhu kabhuku re sebhe dhimu.

source_text: they are descendants of shem. they became groups that had their own clans, their own languages, and their own land.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu sem. èci-èci ka dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra.

source_text: all those groups descended from the sons of noah. each group had its own ◄genealogy/record of people's ancestors► and each became a separate ethnic group. those ethnic groups formed after the flood and spread all around the earth.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu noh, èci-èci ka dènge suku ra. ropa èi aae lala èle, rèngu se'e ka pea papènu lème rai-haha ne.

source_text: at first, all the people in mty the world spoke the same language dou.
target_text: uru-uru tèka na, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, dhoka lii èci di.

source_text: as people moved further east, they arrived at a plain in babylonia region and began to live there.
target_text: lod'o rèngu cahag'e lasi asa ca bèka dhimu, ra d'ai era mera ètu sinear, ka ra pea ètu èèna.

source_text: then they said to each other, ◄hey/come on►, let's form bricks and bake them to make them hard, for building! so they used bricks instead of stones, and used tar instead of ◄mortar/a mixture of cement, sand and lime► to hold them together. they said, hey, let's build a city for ourselves! we also ought to build a very high tower that reaches up to the sky! in that way we will become famous! if we do not do this, we will be scattered all over the earth!
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i rare lii èci, aku rèngu na, a'ari, ee! mai ta patitu kota kapai aae cue. ti tao hadhu bata; ti tunu pa'adhu. èèna na, èdhi pudhi sa dedha, ho ti tape dènge èi dama. ho èèna na, ti patitu manara dedha aae èci, dhu kolo nèngu na d'ai dedha-liru, sèna ka èdhi abhu kolongara kapai. ho sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i ca kabarai aae, dhu pahag'a ia ka.

source_text: so they began to build the city and the tower. then yahweh looked down and saw the city and the tower that those puny men were building.
target_text: hèia lamatua puru mai laladhe kota dènge manara dhu ra patitu èèna.

source_text: yahweh said, these people are one group that all speak the same language. if they have begun to do this now, then ◄there is nothing that they will decide to do that will be impossible for them/they will be able to do whatever they decide to do► lit!
target_text: ka na peka na, dhèu rai-haha se, aa'i-aa'i ra ca kabarai, dènge lii èci di. ngaa dhu rèngu tao ne, heka mulai kèna. bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i mi èci sèmi ne'e, èèna na, ngaa dhu rèngu neo tao, j'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: so, okay/now, we will go down there and cause there to be many different languages, so that they will not be able to understand each other.
target_text: de be'a risi, èdhi puru lati ho tao lii si baka-leo, ho sèna ka èci ne'a boe lii èci.

source_text: so yahweh did that. as a result, the people stopped building the city, and yahweh caused them to disperse all over the earth.
target_text: hèia lamatua puru, ka kakeho lii ra. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, na pacèri si palème rai-haha ne. ka ra pakèd'i taruu heka kota deo na.

source_text: the city was called babel which means ‘confusion', because there yahweh caused the people to become confused because the people mty spoke different languages that the others could not understand, not just one language. from there yahweh caused them to disperse all over the earth.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra pangare kota na, babel dhu sasoa na ‘pab'ingu', lula lamatua kakeho lii ra, aa pacèri eele si palème rai-haha ne.

source_text: ◄this is a bigger list/i will now tell you more► of the descendants of shem: two years after the flood, when shem was 100 years old, he became the father of arpachshad.
target_text: se'e se, ana-èpu sem. ropa èle èi aae lala dua tèu sa, sem mamuri cangasu tèu kèna, ka na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na arpaksad.

source_text: after arpachshad was born, shem lived 500 more years and had more sons and daughters.
target_text: ka sem mamuri hari d'ai lèmi ngasu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when arphachshad was 35 years old, he became the father of shelah.
target_text: lod'o umur arpaksad d'ai tèlu nguru lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na sela.

source_text: after shelah was born, arpachshad lived 403 more years and became the father of more sons and daughters.
target_text: ka arpaksad mamuri hari d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when shelah was 30 years old, he became the father of eber.
target_text: lod'o umur sela d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na eber.

source_text: after eber was born, shelah lived 403 more years and became the father of other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka sela mamuri hari d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when eber was 34 years old, he became the father of peleg.
target_text: lod'o umur eber d'ai tèlu nguru èpa tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na pelek.

source_text: after peleg was born, eber lived 430 more years and became the father of other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka eber mamuri era d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when peleg was 30 years old, he became the father of reu.
target_text: lod'o umur pelek d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na rehu.

source_text: after reu was born, peleg lived 209 more years and became the father of other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka pelek mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu ceo tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when reu was 32 years old, he became the father of serug.
target_text: lod'o umur rehu d'ai tèlu nguru dua tèu, na abhu ana mone èci, ngara na seruk.

source_text: after serug was born, reu lived 207 more years and became the father of other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka rehu mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu pidhu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when serug was 30 years old, he became the father of nahor.
target_text: lod'o umur seruk d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na nahor.

source_text: after nahor was born, serug lived 200 more years and became the father of other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka seruk mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when nahor was 29 years old, he became the father of terah.
target_text: lod'o umur nahor d'ai dua nguru ceo tèu, na abhu ana mone èci, ngara na tera.

source_text: after terah was born, nahor lived 119 more years and became the father of other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka nahor mamuri era d'ai cangasu canguru ceo tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when terah was 70 years old, his son abram was born. later, two other sons, nahor and haran were born.
target_text: lod'o umur tera d'ai pidhu nguru tèu risi, na abhu ana mone, dhèu tèlu: abram, nahor, dènge haran.

source_text: ◄this is/i will now give► a list of the descendants of terah: terah's sons were abram, nahor, and haran. haran's son was named lot.
target_text: ana-èpu tera, sèmi ne'e: ana mone na, ka: abram, nahor, dènge haran. haran abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na lot.

source_text: haran died before his father died. he died in ur city in chaldea land, where he was born.
target_text: haran madhe ètu rae èta-èsu na, ngara na ur, rai dhèu kasdim. lod'o èèna, ama na tera mamuri era.

source_text: abram and nahor both married. abram's wife was named sarai, and nahor's wife was named milcah. milcah and her younger sister iscah were the daughters of haran.
target_text: abram madhèdi dènge sarai. nahor leo dènge ana bhèni haran, ngara na milka. haran abhu ana mone èci kahèi, ngara na yiska.

source_text: sarai was unable to bear any children.
target_text: te ngaa sarai dènge boe ana.

source_text: terah decided to leave ur and go to live in canaan land. so he took his son abram and his grandson lot, the son of haran, and abram's wife sarai with him. but instead of going to canaan, they stopped at haran town and lived there.
target_text: ca tèka, tera nèti ana na abram, dènge sarai dhèu èmu abram, dènge èpu na lot, lasi tèke eele rae ur, neo lasi asa rai kana'an. te ngaa lasi d'ai rae haran, rèngu pea ka ètu èèna.

source_text: when terah was 205 years old, he died there in haran.
target_text: tera madhe ètu èèna, dènge umur na dua ngasu lèmi tèu.

source_text: then yahweh said to abram, leave this country where you are now living. leave your father's clan and his family. go to a land that i will show you.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lamatua peka le dènge abram, peka na, abram! èu pakèd'i nèti era èu ne, tèke eele ina-ama èu, èmu ina-ama mu, dènge rae-lesa èu. lamu asa era èci, dhu pe ja'a peka dènge èu.

source_text: i will cause your descendants to become a large nation. i will bless you and cause you to become ◄famous/highly esteemed►. what i do for you will be a blessing to others.
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia mèngi-nale mi èu. aa ana-èpu èu, èèna na, bèba-kacanga, j'aj'i suku dhu kapai, toke dhèu tadhe kolongara èu. ho bèli-camèd'a, èu j'aj'i berkat hia dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: i will bless those who ◄bless/ask god to do good things for► you, and i will ◄curse/ask god to punish► those who do evil things to you. and because of what you do, groups of people all over the earth will receive blessings or, people will wish that god will bless others as much as he has blessed you.
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia berkat mi dhèu dhu hia berkat mi èu. te ngaa ja'a huku dhèu cee dhu dhoo èu. nanene paie! pe èèna na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu berkat lula èu.

source_text: so abram left haran town, as yahweh told him to do. abram was 75 years old when he left there along with his wife, sarai, and his nephew, lot. abram also took along all the possessions and slaves that they had accumulated/acquired in haran town, and they left there and went to canaan land.
target_text: lod'o èèna, umur abram pidhu nguru lèmi tèu. na nèti dhèu èmu na sarai, aa dènge ana ari na, lot, dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge dhèu sab'a na aa'i-aa'i dhu na abhu ètu kota haran. hèia abram si lasi ka, tèke eele kota haran, asa era dhu lamatua peka le dènge ne. ka ra kako taruu, d'ai rai èci, ngara na kana'an.

source_text: in canaan they traveled as far as shechem town and camped by a huge tree called the tree of moreh. the canaan people-group were still living in that land.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, abram kako palème rai ne, toke d'ai padètu dènge rae èci, ngara na sikem. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna, padètu dènge aj'u aae ca kapua ètu more. lod'o èèna, dhèu kana'an dhu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: then yahweh appeared to abram and said to him, i will give this land to your descendants. then abram built a stone altar to offer a sacrifice to yahweh because yahweh had appeared to him.
target_text: ètu era èèna ka, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi abram, peka na, èèna na, ja'a hia ana-èpu èu rai ne'e ne. ka abram pudhi hadhu tao mei korban hia lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi na dènge nèngu ètu era èèna.

source_text: from shechem, abram and his family traveled to the hills that were east of bethel town. bethel town was to the west of where they set up their tent, and ai town was further to the east. there he built another stone altar and offered a sacrifice and worshiped yahweh there.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abram si pidha hari asa ledhe re balèu. ka ra pea taha ètu talora rae betel dènge rae ai. ètu èèna, na patitu mei korban èci ho na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: then they left there and started traveling south to the negev desert.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na pidha-pidha era, d'ai rai negeb re ca bèka balèu nèti rai kana'an.

source_text: there was ◄a famine/very little food to eat► in canaan, so they went south to live in egypt for a while.
target_text: ca tèka, rai kana'an lèke manganga aae. nèti èèna ka, abram si lasi asa bèka balèu, ka ra d'ai rai masir. ka ra manubha taha ètu nèi.

source_text: just as they were about to enter egypt, abram said to his wife sarai, listen, i know that you are a very beautiful woman.
target_text: ropa oe d'ai masir, abram peka dènge dhèu èmu na, sarai, aku nèngu na, sarai, èu bhèni iia, nia boe.

source_text: when the people in egypt see you, they will say, ‘this woman is his wife! ' and they will kill me in order to get you, but they will not kill you.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu masir rèdhi èu bhèni iia sèmi ne'e, mage dhoka ra pamadhe ja'a, lula ja'a dhèu èmu-kamali èu. dènge sèmi èèna, ra parame rare èu.

source_text: so i ask you to tell them that you are my sister, so that because of you telling them that, they will ◄spare my life/not kill me►.
target_text: de be'a risi, èu peka dènge ra, na ja'a ne, ana mone èu. dènge sèmi èèna ka, rèngu pamadhe boe ja'a, aa ra be'a-be'a dènge ja'a, lula èu ne.

source_text: and as soon as they arrived in egypt, the people in egypt saw that his wife was indeed very beautiful.
target_text: ropa abram si d'ai masir, dhèu ètu èèna, ladhe laa na, sarai ne bhèni iia titu kèna.

source_text: when the king's officials saw her, they told the king how beautiful she was. and they took her to the king's palace.
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a dhèu aae sèra ladhe rèdhi ne, aa ra koa bhabhèni iia na ètu madha dhèu aae. ka rèti bhèni ne, asa èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: the king treated abram kindly because of sarai, and he gave abram many sheep and cattle and donkeys and male and female slaves and camels.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae be'a-be'a ka dènge abram, lula sarai. ka na parasee abram mèdha rupa-rupa. nuka badha sèmi: kahib'i-kalèbho, kahib'i-ka'ia, sapi, keled'ei, dènge onta. na parasee kahèi, ènu dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: but because the king had taken sarai, abram's wife, yahweh caused the king and the others in his household to be inflicted with terrible diseases.
target_text: lula na nare dhèu èmu dhèu asa d'ara èmu na, nèti èèna ka, lamatua hia huku rupa-rupa mi dhèu aae dènge isi èmu na.

source_text: when the king realized why that was happening, he summoned abram and said to him, why did you do this to me? why did you not tell me that she was your wife?
target_text: hèia dhèu aae masir paroa abram, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu ne tao tasamia mi ja'a ne? nga tao ka èu peka boe na, bhèni ne dhèu èmu èu?

source_text: why did you lie, saying she is your sister, with the result that i took her to be my wife? you should not have done that! so now take your wife, leave here and go!
target_text: te ngaa aku èu na, nèngu ne ana hèni èu! nèti èèna ka, ja'a oe kore ne j'aj'i dhèu èmu ja'a! dhèu èmu èu ka ne'e! more hari ka, aa pakaj'èu ka nèti madha ja'a!

source_text: then the king told his officials/servants to take abram and his wife and all his possessions out of egypt.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae paredha dhèu sab'a na sèra, babège eele abram, dhèu èmu na, rèti dènge dhèu aa mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra, kalua nèti rai èèna.

source_text: so abram and sarai left egypt, and they took along all his possessions, and lot went with them to the negev desert.
target_text: ka abram si tèke eele masir, lasi asa rai negeb. la'e dènge dhèu èmu na, aa dènge dhèu aa mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra. ana ari na lot madhutu ra kahèi.

source_text: abram was very rich. he owned a lot of livestock, silver and gold.
target_text: abram èèna, kaja ae titu kèna. badha-manu na, mèdha hualaa dènge mèdha hualaa-pudhi na, ae titu kèna.

source_text: they continued traveling from place to place from the negev desert toward bethel town to the place between bethel and ai where they had previously set up their tents,
target_text: nèti negeb, ra pidha-pidha era, ka d'ai hari talora rae betel dènge rae ai. dhu uru èèna, ra pea rèdhi le ètu era èèna.

source_text: and where abram had made a stone altar and worshiped yahweh.
target_text: aa dhu abram patitu le kahèi mei korban, ho na mangaj'i mi lamatua ètu era èèna.

source_text: lot, who was traveling with abram, also had flocks of sheep and goats and herds of cattle, and tents.
target_text: lot dhu madhutu abram èèna, unu badha-manu dènge dhèu sab'a ae kahèi.

source_text: but they had so many animals that they could not all stay in the same area. there was not enough land to provide water and food for all their animals. furthermore, the descendants of canaan and perizzi were also living in that area, and the land really belonged to them. and the men who took care of abram's animals started quarreling with the men who took care of lot's animals.
target_text: te ngaa era èèna taleo boe, ho abram dènge lot aa dènge kakaja ra bisa pea pa'èci. nèti èèna ka, ana madhenge badha abram dènge lot sèra j'aj'i patao-palaha, lula j'u'u ètu era èèna d'ai boe hia badha rèngu. lod'o èèna, dhèu kana'an dènge dhèu feris, dhu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: so abram said to lot, since we are close relatives, it is not good for us two to quarrel, or for the men who take care of your animals to quarrel with the men who take care of my animals.
target_text: ka abram peka dènge lot, aku nèngu na, èdhi se, pa'a'ari. mage dhoka èdhi, èci dènge èci be'a boe, lula dhèu sab'a èdhi se patao-palaha taruu.

source_text: there is plenty of land for both of us. so we should separate. you can choose whatever part you want rhq. if you want the area over there, i will stay here. if you want the area here, i will go over there.
target_text: de hua iia dua ti pahag'a ka laa. rai ne, taleo. de ladhe èu d'èi rai ca bèka kariu na, ja'a abhu re ca bèka g'ana. te ngaa ladhe èu d'èi re ca bèka g'ana, na ja'a re ca bèka kariu.

source_text: lot looked around toward zoar town, and saw that there was plenty of water all over the plain near the jordan river. it was like the park/garden in eden, and like the land in egypt. that was before yahweh destroyed the cities of sodom and gomorrah which were on that plain.
target_text: hèia lot ladhe palème. ka na ladhe nèdhi rai taleo ètu sebhe loko yarden dhu madha èi ae, toke d'ai rae soar. era ne, rai hèu mèngi sama sèmi oka lamatua, dènge rai masir kahèi. lod'o èèna, lamatua dhae huku mèka kota sodom dènge kota gomora. de rai èèna, be'a era.

source_text: so lot chose the land in the plain of the jordan river. he left his uncle, abram, and moved east.
target_text: hèia lot pili nare era sebhe loko yarden èèna. ka dua ra pahag'e ka. de lot la'e sa ca bèka dhimu.

source_text: abram stayed in the canaan area, and lot started to live near the cities in the plain of the jordan river, and he set up his tents near sodom city.
target_text: te ngaa abram pea taruu ètu rai kana'an. aa lot la'e pea ètu rae-rae dhu padètu dènge kota sodom ètu sebhe loko yarden.

source_text: you need to know that people who lived there were extremely wicked.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu-dhèu sodom sèra bhelu-katub'a titu kèna. rèngu ro'o boe nanene lamatua.

source_text: after abram and lot separated, yahweh said to abram, look around at this whole area where you are. look north and south, look east and west.
target_text: ropa lot pacèri dènge abram, ka lamatua padhai lii dènge abram, peka na, èu ladhe palème aa'i ku, rai aa'i-aa'i nèti era titu èu èèna. ladhe paie re madha, re kabodho, re ca bèka g'ana, dènge ca bèka kariu mu.

source_text: i will give to you and your descendants all the land that you see; i will give it to you forever.
target_text: rai aa'i-aa'i dhu èu ladhe mèdhi sèi, bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia mi èu, dènge ana-èpu èu, sèna ka j'aj'i pusaka ra, toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: i will cause your descendants to be as numerous as particles of dust! it will be easier to count the particles of dust than it will be to count your descendants hyp.
target_text: èèna na ja'a paj'aj'i ana-èpu èu ae sama sèmi salae dhasi, toke dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: walk through the land in every direction, because i am going to give it all to you.
target_text: de lamu kako palème madhutu madhera dènge bhabhèla na. te rai se aa'i-aa'i ra, ja'a hia mi èu.

source_text: so abram and his men took down their tents and moved to hebron and started to live by the huge trees at the town of mamre. he placed a stone altar there to make sacrifices to yahweh.
target_text: hèia abram si lèpa hari asa era pea ra, dhu dètu dènge aj'u-aj'u aae ètu mamre, dhu padètu dènge hebron. èle èèna ka, na pudhi hadhu tao mei korban ho na mangaj'i lamatua ètu èèna.

source_text: in a region to the east, there were four kings who were friends/allies. they were king amraphel of babylonia, king arioch of ellasar, king chedorlaomer of elam, and king tidal of goiim.
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae èpa dhu pa'èci. rèngu se ka: amrafel, dhèu aae rai sinear. ariok, dhèu aae rai elasar, kedarlaomer, dhèu aae rai elam. dènge tideal, dhèu aae rai goyim.

source_text: in an area to the west, there were five other kings. they were king bera of sodom, king birsha of gomorrah, king shinab of admah, king shemeber of zeboiim, and the king of bela, the city that is now called zoar.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae leo dhèu lèmi, pa'èci kahèi. nuka: bera, dhèu aae rai sodom. birsa, dhèu aae rai gomora. sinab, dhèu aae rai adema. semeber, dhèu aae rai seboim. dènge bela, dhèu aae rai soar. ka èpa dhèu aae se, lasi pamusu dènge lèmi dhèu aae sèra.

source_text: those five kings and their armies gathered together in siddim valley, which is also called the dead sea valley, to fight against the four kings and their armies. king chedorlaomer and his army conquered the armies of those five kings, and demanded that those kings pay him tribute money each year.
target_text: dhèu aae, dhèu lèmi sèra pakaboko dènge sordad'u ra, ètu d'ara mamoo sidim, dhu limuri ne, ngara na dhasi madhe.

source_text: for twelve years he ruled them. but during the thirteenth year they rebelled and refused to keep giving him tribute money.
target_text: j'aj'aj'i pamusu na, sèmi ne'e ka: uru èèna, dhèu aae, dhèu lèmi se dhu ta'alo mi dhèu aae kedarlaomer, canguru dua tèu kèna. te d'ai tèu ka canguru tèlu, ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra lab'a ne.

source_text: the next year, king chedorlaomer and the other kings that were his allies took their armies and defeated the repha people-group in ashteroth-karnaim and the zuz people-group in ham, and the emi people-group in shaveh-kiriathaim.
target_text: ka maso tèu ka canguru èpa, kedarlaomer dènge angalai na dhèu aae dhèu tèlu sera, mai dènge sordad'u ra. hèia ra pamusu ka, ka ra segi pèri-pèri rai. nuka: dhèu refaim ètu rai asterot-karnaim; dhèu susim ètu rai ham; dhèu emim ètu rai sawe-kiryataim,

source_text: they also defeated the hor people-group in the hilly area of seir as far as el-paran near the desert.
target_text: dènge dhèu hori dhu ètu ledhe seir, d'ai sebhe mamoo el paran.

source_text: then they turned back and went to mishpat city, which is now called kadesh. they conquered all the land belonging to the amalek people-group and the amor people-group who were living in hazazon-tamar town.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lèpa hari asa en mispat dhu limuri ne ngara na kades. ka ra segi rai dhèu amalek, dènge dhèu amori dhu pea ètu rae haseson-tamar.

source_text: then the armies of the kings of sodom, gomorrah, admah, zeboiim and bela marched out to fight the armies of the other four kings in siddim valley. that valley is close to the salt/dead sea. they fought against the armies of chedorlaomer the king of elam, tidal the king of goiim, amraphel the king of shinar, and arioch the king of ellasar. the armies of four kings were fighting against the armies of five kings.
target_text: hèia, lèmi dhèu aae se ator sordad'u ra ètu d'ara mamoo sidim, ka lasi pamusu dènge dhèu aae dhèu èpa sèra.

source_text: the siddim valley was full of tar pits. so when the armies of the kings of sodom and gomorrah tried to run away, many of the men fell into the tar pits. the others escaped and ran away to the hills.
target_text: ètu d'ara mamoo èèna, dhu abhu mananga èi dama pèri-pèri. ropa ra pamusu, dhèu aae sodom dènge dhèu aae gomora dènge sordad'u ra, rai. ka cahag'e manahu asa d'ara mananga èi dama se. aa cahag'e hari rai asa ledhe lasi.

source_text: as the armies of the five kings fled, the armies of the four kings seized all of the valuable things in sodom and gomorrah, including all the food.
target_text: ka èpa dhèu aae dhu segi se, lasi parame rèti mèdha-panyau dènge nganga'a-nginu nèti sodom dènge gomora. èèna ka, ra lèpa dènge ka.

source_text: they also captured abram's nephew lot and his possessions, since he was living in sodom at that time.
target_text: te ngaa lot, ana ari abram, dhu pea ètu sodom. ka èpa dhèu aae sèra, ère rèti lot si, dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: abram was living near the big trees near mamre, who belonged to the amor people-group. abram had made an agreement with mamre and his two brothers, eshcol and aner, that they would help each other if there was a war.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èci rai nèti era èèna. ka la'e lolo dènge abram, dhèu ibrani èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu amori èci, ngara na mamre. aa abram pea dètu dènge aj'u-aj'u aae unu mamre. a'ari mamre dhèu dua, ngara na eskol dènge aner. rèngu se dhu pa'anga dènge abram.

source_text: one of the men who escaped from the battle told abram what had happened and that his nephew lot had been captured and taken away. so abram summoned 318 men who were his servants, men who had been with abram since they were born. they all went together and pursued their enemies as far north as dan city.
target_text: ropa abram tadèngi na dhèu kèpe rèti le lot, ana ari na, ka abram pakaboko nare dhèu-dhèu sab'a na dhu re'a pamusu. aa'i-aa'i ra tèlu ngasu canguru aru dhèu. ka lasi magèla èpa dhèu aae sèra, asa badae aae lasi d'ai rae dan.

source_text: during the night, abram divided the men into several groups, and they attacked their enemies from various directions and defeated them. they pursued them as far as hobah, which was north of damascus city.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abram hag'e dhèu na sèra, mi pèri-pèri kaboko. d'ara mèda èèna kahèi, lasi age si, dènge j'ara pa'oke. ka abram si lasi bate dhèu se d'ai rae hoba, ètu bèka badae kota damsik.

source_text: abram's men recovered all of the goods that had been taken. they also rescued lot and all his possessions and also the women and others who had been captured by their enemies.
target_text: hèia abram abhu hari lot, dènge dhèu-dhèu nèngu, aa dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i. na abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu leo.

source_text: as abram was returning home after he and his men had defeated the armies of king chedorlaomer and the other kings who had fought alongside him, the king of sodom went north to meet him in shaveh valley, which people call the king's valley.
target_text: ropa abram segi nare dhèu aae èpa sèra, ka na lèpa. hèia dhèu aae sodom mai soru ne ètu d'ara mamoo sawe dhu dhèu biasa peka na, mamoo dhèu aae.

source_text: the king of salem city, whose name was melchizedek, was also a priest who offered sacrifices to the supreme god. he brought some bread and wine to abram.
target_text: tèu èèna, melkisedek, j'aj'i dhèu aae kota salem. aa nèngu ne j'aj'i kahèi ama agama nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele. na mai soru abram, nèti roti dènge èi hua anggor.

source_text: then he blessed abram, saying i ask the supreme god, the one who created heaven and earth, to bless you. the supreme god has enabled you to defeat mty your enemies, so we should praise/thank him. then abram gave to melchizedek a tenth part of all the things he had captured.
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho hia berkat mi abram, aku nèngu na, ja'a sanao sèna ka ama lamatua, dhu dedha risi eele èèna, dhu paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne, hia mèngi-nale mi dedha èu. koa-kio ama lamatua dhu hia le èu segi musu. èle èèna ka, abram bagi hia melkisedek ca pala nèti canguru pala mèdha-panyau dhu na abhu hari sèra.

source_text: the king of sodom said to abram, you can keep all the goods you recovered. just let me take back the people from my city whom you rescued.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae sodom èèna pahaha iisi na mi abram, peka na, ama. mèdha-panyau dhu èu abhu hari nèti musu ja'a sèra, hud'i laa ama ku abhu aa'i si. te ngaa dhu ja'a manèngi hari, dhoka dhèu-dhèu ja'a sèra.

source_text: but abram said to the king of sodom, i have solemnly promised mty to yahweh, the supreme god, the one who created heaven and earth,
target_text: hèia abram b'ala ne, peka na, ja'a subha ètu madha ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele, dhu tao dedha-liru dènge rai-haha,

source_text: that i will not accept even one thread or a thong of a sandal from anything that belongs to you. as a result, you will never be able to say, ‘i caused abram to become rich. '
target_text: na, ja'a kore boe mèdha-panyau èu, masi ka ciki èèna ka. masi ka loa hèngu ca'èta sa, ja'a kore boe. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èu baku peka na, ‘kakaja abram sèra mai nèti ja'a. '

source_text: the only thing i will accept is the food that my men have eaten. but aner, eshcol, and mamre went with me and fought alongside me, so let them also have a share of the goods we brought back. so the king of sodom agreed to what he said.
target_text: ja'a parluu boe ngaa-ngaa. dhoka mia dhu dhèu ja'a se pake le, sèra èle le, ale ia ka. aa hud'i laa, angalai ja'a dhèu tèlu se: aner, eskol dènge mamre, hag'e rare unu rèngu di.

source_text: some time later, abram had a vision in which yahweh spoke to him and said, do not be afraid of ◄anything/your enemies►. i will protect you mty, and i will give a great reward.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi abram. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, abram! èu baku madha'u. lula ja'a ka dhu j'aj'i mi tami ho bhiri èu nèti musu. aa ja'a hia a'oto mi dedha èu.

source_text: but abram replied, yahweh god, how can you give me what i truly want, because i have no children, and the one who will be like a son and inherit all my possessions is my servant eliezer from damascus! abram added, you have not given me any children, so think about this: a servant in my household will inherit all i own!
target_text: te ngaa, aku abram na, masi ka ama lamatua hia ae-ae èèna ka, j'aj'i boe mi ngaa sa èci. lula ja'a ne dènge boe ana matana, ho hia ja'a ana-èpu. de dhu neo unu ae-ae sèmi èèna, tao mi ngaa? neu-neu ka, noto mi ènu ja'a elieser, dhèu damsik èèna. nèngu ka dhu sèmi nare aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: yahweh replied, no! he will not be the one who will inherit it. instead, you yourself will be the father of the one who will inherit everything you own.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua dhaa na, j'ara na sèmi boe èèna! ana d'èlu èu ku, dhu unu pusaka sèra. ènu èu abhu boe.

source_text: then yahweh took abram outside of his tent and said, look up at the sky! can you count the stars? no, you cannot count them because there are so many of them, and your descendants will be as numerous as the stars.
target_text: hèia nèti abram asa li'u, ka na peka, èu ladhe ku asa dedha-liru nèi. ladhe paie ku hua-hètu sèi. bisa iga more, do aad'o? bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu èu sama sèmi hua-hètu sèi!

source_text: abram believed that what yahweh said would happen. and because of that, yahweh considered that abram was righteous.
target_text: ka abram sèmi nare lii padhai lamatua. aa lamatua tadhe ne, dhèu mola, lula abram lèka ne.

source_text: yahweh also said to him, i am yahweh. i am the one who brought you from ur in chaldea land. i brought you here to give you this land to possess.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua tuhu hari lii na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua. ja'a ka dhu lere kèti èu nèti rae ur, ètu rai dhèu kasdim sèra. aa rai ne'e ne, ja'a hia èu, sèna ka j'aj'i pusaka mu.

source_text: but abram replied, yahweh god, how can i know for sure that this land will belong to me?
target_text: te ngaa abram karèi, aku nèngu na, tasamia, lamatua? dènge j'ara sa mia ka ho ja'a ke'a na, rai ne j'aj'i pusaka ja'a?

source_text: god said to him, bring a three-year-old heifer and a three-year-old goat to me, and a dove and a pigeon.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! mai ti tao madha j'ara èci, dhu pa'èki lii padhai lii ja'a deo na. de lamu more sapi rena ci'u, kahib'i rena ci'u, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho mone ci'u. aa'i-aa'i sèra hud'i dhu umur tèlu tèu. aa mèti kahèi koro iia ci'u, dènge koro j'aha ci'u.

source_text: so abram brought all of them and killed them and cut each of the animals in half. he arranged the halves of each one, side by side. but he did not cut the pigeon and dove in half.
target_text: ka abram la'e nare badha sèra. hèia na kacèb'e bagi mi dua, sapi, kahib'i, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho sèra. ka na pale sisi se mi rai, dhu èci patangara dènge èci, j'aj'i mi dua b'aris. te ngaa na kacèb'e boe manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: birds that eat dead flesh came down to eat the carcasses, but abram shooed them away.
target_text: ka manu-bhui dhu tema ra'a sisi sèra, mai ho neo ra'a sisi se'e. te ngaa abram bhabhoo eele si.

source_text: as the sun was going down, abram fell sound asleep, and suddenly everything around him became dark and frightening.
target_text: ropa lod'o cèna, abram bhèj'i luu. na nii, kuri na maroga mai sarimu nare nèngu, ka na madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: then god said to abram, i want you to know that your descendants will become foreigners living in a land that does not belong to them. they will become slaves of the owners of that land. the owners of the land will mistreat them for 400 years. but then i will punish the people of that country that made them become slaves, and then your descendants will leave that country, taking many possessions with them. but as for you, you will die eup peacefully when you are very old.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, abram! èèna na èu mamuri toke heka bhoro, aa madhe dènge be'a, ka ra padhane èu dènge be'a. te ngaa ana-èpu èu, èèna na j'aj'i dhèu tao mai ètu kabarai dhèu. ho èèna na, dhèu isi rai sèra, tao si sèmi ènu sa, ka ra ènyi aa paj'èra si, toke èpa ngasu tèu. te, ladhe èèna na, ja'a huku si. ho èèna na, ja'a kèti hari ana-èpu èu nèti era èèna, aa dènge mèdha-panyau ra ae-ae.

source_text: after your descendants have been slaves for 400 years, they will return here, and take control of this land and defeat the amor people-group. those people will, because those people have not yet sinned enough to deserve to be punished now.
target_text: aa èèna na, ja'a ator ho ana-èpu èu dhu ka lèmi kèti hari si asa ne'e mai. limuri ne, dhèu amori dhu pea ètu rai ne'e. dhèu se'e dhèu bhelu, te ngaa dhae bhelu iia mèka. ladhe ana-èpu èu sèra lèpa hari asa era ne'e, ja'a neo pake si ho huku palaho dhèu amori sèra. lula d'ai taa èèna, bhabhelu ra asa hino.

source_text: when the sun had set and it had become dark, unexpectedly a blazing torch and a clay pot containing burning coals from which smoke was rising appeared and went between the halves of the animals.
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda sa, cag'ag'a laa ètu era èèna, abhu èru rai èci dhu sèb'u poka-poka, dènge badhu ai èci dhu heo, kako re sasanga sisi dua baris se.

source_text: and on that day yahweh made an agreement with abram. yahweh told him, i will give to your descendants all the land between the river that is on the eastern border of egypt to the south, and north to the huge euphrates river.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge abram. na peka na, ja'a jaji mema èu kèna, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pangèd'u mi ana-èpu èu rai ne'e ne, mulai nèti loko masir, d'ai loko efrat,

source_text: that is the land where the ken, the keniz, the kidmon,
target_text: dènge rai dhèu keni, dhèu kenas, dhèu kadmon,

source_text: before he finished praying, amazingly, rebekah arrived there, carrying a jar on her shoulder. she was the daughter of bethuel, who was the son of milcah, the wife of abraham's younger brother nahor. she was very beautiful and still a virgin. she went down to the edge of the well, filled her jar with water, and then came back up.

target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, dhèu sab'a ne pacud'u kètu d'ai rai, ka na manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: then the servant brought out silver and gold jewelry and clothes, and gave them to rebekah. and he gave gifts to her brother laban and to her mother.

source_text: but her brother and her mother replied, let the girl remain with us for about ten days. after that, you may take her and go.
target_text: te ngaa ana mone dènge ina ana bhèni na, peka na, te neo hari lèpa lai-lai, tao ngaa ne? hud'i ribka pea hari ku dènge ji'i d'ai canguru lod'o sa laa ma, heka lami kèna.

source_text: but he replied to them, yahweh has made my journey successful, so do not detain me. let me take her back to my master now!
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a èèna dhaa, peka na, waa! baku kai ja'a! te lamatua sue le ja'a, ka toke ja'a rage le bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak. de patabuli ka ji'i se, la'a peka ku dènge lamatua ji'i abraham.

source_text: they said, let's call rebekah and ask her what she wants to do. mty
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, sèmi ne'e ka laa! mai ti karèi ribka, sèna ka te'a dad'èi na tasa mera mia?

source_text: so they summoned rebekah and asked her, will you go with this man now? she replied, yes, i will go.
target_text: hèia ra paroa ne, aku rèngu na, ribka! di aku èu kèna. èu neo lamu dènge ka dènge dhèu ne'e do, tasamia? ka ribka dhaa, peka na, ja'a ko'o.

source_text: so they allowed rebekah, a woman who had taken care of her when she was very young, abraham's servant, and the men who had come with him. to go. before they all left, they asked god to bless rebekah, and said to her, our sister, we ask that yahweh will cause you to have millions of descendants, and allow them to completely defeat met all those that hate them.
target_text: hèia ra hia ribka dènge bhèni dhu leru ne karèi nèti ana iiki ka, ho lasi palere dènge dhèu sab'a abraham sèra. ka ra hia ribka mèngi-nale, aku rèngu na, ji'i sanao-maena sèna ka ama lamatua hia èu mora iisi ana ae-ae, ho ana-èpu mu d'ai riho-kehi. aa ji'i sanao kahèi, sèna ka ana-èpu èu sèra segi aa'i musu rèngu sèra!

source_text: then rebekah and her maid servants got ready and got on their camels and went with abraham's servant.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ribka dènge bhèni dhu leru nèngu na lalau ka mèdha ra, ka ra ca'e onta, pakèd'i dènge ka, madhutu dhèu sab'a abraham sèra.

source_text: at that time, isaac was living in the negev desert. he had gone there from beer-lahai-roi.
target_text: isak pea ètu rai negeb. lod'o èèna, na heka lèpa kèna nèti madha èi beer lahai roi.

source_text: one evening he went out into the field to meditate as he walked. he looked up and was surprised to see some camels coming.
target_text: d'ara lod'o nihia ca lod'o, na kalua nèti d'ara paleo na, la'e pasiar ciki. ropa na boti kètu, na ladhe laa na onta-onta kako mai asa era nèngu na.

source_text: rebekah also looked up and saw isaac. she got off the camel,
target_text: ropa ribka ladhe nèdhi isak, hèia na puru lai-lai nèti dedha onta.

source_text: and asked the servant, who is that man who is approaching? the servant replied, that is isaac, my master, the man you will be marrying. so she took her veil and covered her face, which was the custom for a woman who was about to be married.
target_text: ka na karèi dhèu sab'a abraham, aku nèngu na, dhèu mone cee ka mai nèi? ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu na, ana lamatua ja'a kèna. hèia ribka nare salalu na, pa'abhe rèhu na.

source_text: the servant told isaac everything that had happened.
target_text: ka dhèu sab'a ne lolo dènge isak, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: then isaac took rebekah into the tent that belonged to his mother, sarah, and she became his wife. and he loved her. so isaac was comforted about his mother's death.
target_text: hèia isak todhe nèti ka ribka lasi asa d'ara paleo ina na, ka dua ra paleo ka èmu. lula isak sue seli eele ribka, ka na susa heka dènge mamadhe ina na.

source_text: some time after sarah died, abraham married another woman, whose name was keturah.
target_text: ka abraham leo hari èmu dènge bhèni èci, ngara na ketura.

source_text: she later gave birth to six sons: zimran, jokshan, medan, midian, ishbak, and shuah.
target_text: hèia ketura matana ana hia ne. ana se, ngara ra: simran, yoksan, medan, midian, isbak, dènge sua.

source_text: jokshan became the father of two sons, sheba and dedan. the descendants of dedan were the asshur people-group, the letush people-group, and the leum people-group.
target_text: ana yoksan ka: seba dènge dedan. ana-èpu dedan nuka, dhèu asyur, dhèu letus, dènge dhèu leum.

source_text: the sons of midian were ephah, epher, hanoch, abida, and eldaah. they were all descendants of keturah.
target_text: ana midian ka: efa, efer, henok, abida dènge eldaa. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu ketura.

source_text: abraham declared that after he died, isaac would inherit everything he owned. but while abraham was still living, he gave gifts to the sons of his ◄concubines/slaves that he had taken to be his secondary wives►, and then he sent them away to live in a land to the east, to keep them far from his son isaac.
target_text: lod'o dhu abraham mamuri era, na hag'e nare le mèdha-panyau hia ana hagar dènge ana-ana ketura, èci-èci ka dènge unu na. èle èèna ka, abraham pua si lasi pea re bèka dhimu rai kana'an, sèna ka ra pakaj'èu nèti ana na isak. ka pusaka na aa'i-aa'i, na pangèd'u mi ana na isak.

source_text: abraham lived until he was 175 years old. he died at a very old age, joining his ancestors who had died previously dou.
target_text: lod'o umur abraham d'ai ca ngasu pidhu nguru lèmi tèu, na madhe.

source_text: his sons isaac and ishmael buried his body in the cave at machpelah area, near mamre, in the field that abraham had previously bought from ephron, one of the descendants of heth. isaac and ishmael buried his body there, where abraham previously buried his wife sarah.
target_text: ka ana na, isak dènge ismael, padhane ne ètu d'ara loe makpela, dhu padètu dènge mamre. rai ne, dhu uru èèna, abraham hèli nare nèti efron, ana sohar, dhèu het. ka dhu uru èèna, ra padhane le sara ètu d'ara loe èèna.

source_text: after abraham died, god blessed his son isaac. and isaac moved to live near beer-lahai-roi.
target_text: èle madha abraham, ka ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi isak, ka na mamuri mera-milu. lod'o èèna, isak pea dètu dènge madha èi beer lahai roi.

source_text: ◄these are/i will now give a list of► the descendants of abraham's son, ishmael, to whom sarah's female slave, hagar from egypt, had given birth.
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo nèti mamuri ismael. nèngu ne, ana abraham dènge dhèu èmu limuri na, hagar, dhu j'aj'i ènu sara nèti masir.

source_text: these are their names, in the order in which they were born: ishmael's oldest son was named nebaioth. after him were born kedar, adbeel, mibsam, mishma, dumah, massa, hadar, tema, jetur, naphish, and kedemah. the twelve sons of ishmael became the leaders/chiefs of people-groups that had those names. they each had their own settlement and campsite.
target_text: ana-ana ismael, mone dhèu canguru dua. ngara ra dhu madhutu nèti dhu uru tèka d'ai ana limuri tèka, nuka: nebayot, kedar, adbeel, mibsam, misma, duma, masa, hadad, tema, yetur, nafis, dènge kedma. ana-ana sèra ka, j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti canguru dua suku, dhu èci-èci ka dènge kabarai ra. ra pangare kabarai ra èci-èci, madhutu ngara bèi-baki ra.

source_text: ishmael lived until he was 137 years old. then he died, eup joining his ancestors who had previously died.
target_text: ropa umur ismael d'ai cangasu tèlu nguru pidhu tèu, ka na madhe.

source_text: his descendants ◄settled/went to live► in the area between shur and havilah, near the border of egypt as a person travels toward asshur. all of their camps were close to each other or, they all frequently attacked each other.
target_text: te ngaa ana-èpu na sèra, èci pamusu dènge èci. ka ra pea pahag'a, mulai nèti rai hawila d'ai rai syur, dhu palane dènge rai masir, toke d'ai rai asyur.

source_text: ◄this is an account of/i will now tell you about► abraham's son, isaac. abraham became the father of isaac,
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo nèti mamuri isak, ana abraham.

source_text: and when isaac was 40 years old, he married rebekah, the daughter of bethuel. bethuel was one of the descendants of aram from paddan-aram. rebekah was the sister of laban, who belonged to the aram people-group.
target_text: lod'o isak madhèdi dènge ribka, umur na èpa nguru tèu le. ama ribka, ngara na betuel. ana mone ribka, ngara na laban. rèngu se, dhèu aram, nèti padan aram.

source_text: almost 20 years after they were married, rebekah still had no children. so isaac prayed to yahweh concerning his wife, and yahweh answered his prayer. his wife rebekah became pregnant.
target_text: ribka dhu dènge mèka ana. nèti èèna ka, isak manèngi-mangaj'i mi lamatua, sèna ka na bhoke era ana ribka. hèia lamatua tadèngi lii manèngi isak, ka ribka dènge babia.

source_text: she was carrying twins in her womb, and they kept jostling each other. so she said, why is it that this is happening to me? so she asked yahweh about it.
target_text: te ngaa ana dhu ribka kad'o ne, dhèu dua. aa ana se paliku taruu ètu d'ara kabake ina ra. ka ribka ngee ka ètu d'ara na, nga tao ka ana dua se, sèmi ne'e? hèia na pakarèi dènge lamatua.

source_text: yahweh said to her, the older one of your twins will serve the younger one. the twins will be ancestors of two nations. and those two people-groups will separate from each other. chi
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, ètu d'ara kabake èu na, abhu dua suku, dhu èèna na loe boe dènge pamusu. dhu limuri èra risi nèti dhu uru. ka a'a na, lalau-lalo'o ari na.

source_text: when rebekah gave birth, it was true! twin boys were born!
target_text: ropa lod'o d'ai, ribka nara iisi ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: the first one born was red, and his body had hair all over it, like a garment made of hair. so they named him esau, which sounds like the hebrew word that means ‘hairy'.
target_text: dhu a'a, isi na mea, dènge ngi'u na pènu dènge rèu. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare ne, esau dhu sasoa na ‘dènge rèu'.

source_text: then his brother was born, grasping esau's heel. so they named him jacob, which sounds like the hebrew word that means ‘heel'. isaac was 60 years old when the twins were born.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ari na heka kalua kèna. te ngaa dhu na kèpe hui tèdhu a'a na. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare ne, yakob dhu sasoa na ‘hui tèdhu'. lod'o ribka nara iisi ana na se, umur isak èna nguru tèu kèna.

source_text: when the boys grew up, esau became a skilled hunter. he spent a lot of time out in the fields. jacob was a quiet man who stayed close to the campsite.
target_text: lod'o ana dua se kapai, esau dhu ne'a mèu kasiro badha hui. ae ka dhu na pea ètu d'ara j'ami. te ngaa yakob dhu mau-mau, dhu d'èi dhoka pea ètu d'ara èmu di.

source_text: isaac liked esau more, because he enjoyed the taste of the meat of the animals that esau killed. but rebekah liked jacob more.
target_text: isak d'èi na'a sisi badha hui. nèti èèna ka, na sue risi esau. te ngaa ribka sue risi yakob.

source_text: one day while jacob was cooking some stew, esau came home from the field, very hungry.
target_text: ca lod'o, yakob dhu tao bubur kab'ui, aa esau heka lèpa nèti kasiro badha hui kèna. na lèpa dènge manganga, ka roe titu kèna.

source_text: he said to jacob, give me some of that red stew to eat right now, because i am very hungry! that is why esau's other name was edom, which sounds like the hebrew word that means ‘red'.
target_text: ka na peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, ari, ee! hia ku ja'a bubur kab'ui mea ciki ètu d'ara èru èèna, ho ja'a ku'a! te ja'a manganga bia. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare na, edom, dhu sasoa na ‘mea'.

source_text: jacob said, i will give you some if you sell me ◄your birthright/the privileges you have because you are the firstborn son►.
target_text: ka, aku yakob na, be'a a'a. te ngaa pasilu ku dènge hak a'a èèna!

source_text: esau replied, well, i am about to die from being so hungry. if i die now, ◄my birthright will not benefit me. /what good will my birthright be to me? ► rhq
target_text: hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, hak a'a ne, ngaa kèna, hud'i nèngu sèna! neo more, na more la. te ja'a manganga bia. sod'e mèti bubur èèna lai-lai mai, te ja'a taha heka.

source_text: jacob said, ◄swear to/solemnly promise► me that you are giving me the privileges that you will have from being the firstborn son! so that is what esau did. he sold his birthright to jacob.
target_text: te ngaa, aku yakob hari na, mata ku a'a! èu subha uuru ku, dhu peka na, èu pangèd'u le hak a'a èèna mi ja'a ne. ka esau ded'e subha sèmi dhu yakob peka.

source_text: then jacob gave to esau some bread and some stew made of lentils/beans. esau ate and drank, and then he got up and left. by doing that, esau showed that he ◄was not interested in/did not value► the privileges that would be his because of being the firstborn son.
target_text: hèia yakob sod'e dènge ka hia ne bubur kab'ui deo na dènge roti. ropa na'a-ninu nare, ka la'e dènge ka. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, esau pusi boe dènge hak a'a na.

source_text: some time later there was a severe ◄famine/scarcity of food► there. that was different from the famine that occurred when abraham was alive. so isaac went southeast to gerar town, to talk to abimelech, the king of the philistine people-group. what happened was this: isaac considered going to egypt,
target_text: ca tèka, ètu d'ara rai èèna, lèke tèu manganga, èci èèna ka dènge tèu abraham mamuri era. ka isak la'e manèngi abimelek, dhèu aae pilistin, sèna ka na pea ètu gerar.

source_text: but yahweh appeared to him and said, do not go down to egypt! live in the land where i will tell you to go!
target_text: na tao sèmi èèna, lula lamatua dhu pad'elo le iisi na mi nèngu, peka na, mage lamu ka asa masir hèi. pea la mi era dhu èèna na ja'a paj'uj'u hia èu.

source_text: stay in this land for a while, and i will help you and bless you, because it is to you and your descendants that i will give all these lands, and i will do what i solemnly promised to your father. i will cause your descendants to be as numerous as the stars in the sky. i will give to your descendants all these lands, and i will cause your descendants to be a blessing to the people of mty all nations on the earth.
target_text: ladhe èu manubha ètu era èèna, ja'a sama-sama dènge èu, aa pala-bagi èu mèngi-nale rupa-rupa. èèna na, ja'a pabèba ana-èpu èu sama sèmi hua-hètu ètu dedha-liru. aa ja'a hia kateme rai ne mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu. nèti ana-èpu èu ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu mèngi-nale. dènge j'ara ne'e, ja'a tao madhutu lii pajaji dhu ja'a pa'èki le dènge ama mu abraham.

source_text: i will do that because your father abraham obeyed me. he obeyed everything that i told him to do, everything that i declared and all the laws that i gave him. so isaac went and asked king abimelech if he would permit him to live in the gerar area. the king said, okay,
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi ne'e ne, lula ama mu madhutu dad'èi ja'a, paredha ja'a, dènge atora ja'a.

source_text: so isaac stayed there along with his wife and sons.
target_text: ka isak pea taha ètu gerar.

source_text: when the men in gerar town asked who rebekah was, isaac said, she is my sister. he said that because he was afraid to say, she is my wife. he thought, rebekah is very beautiful, so they will want her. if i say that she is my sister, they know they will have to negotiate about a bride price because i am her older brother; but if i say that she is my wife, no negotiation will be possible. they will just kill me to get her.
target_text: ribka ne, bhèni iia titu kèna. ka ropa dhèu ètu gerar ladhe rèdhi ne, ra pakarèi. te ngaa isak peka na, ribka ne, ana hèni ja'a. na madha'u, ladhe na peka na dhèu èmu nèngu, dhèu se pamadhe ne, aa ribka parame rare.

source_text: when isaac had been there a long time, one day abimelech, the king of the philistine people-group, looked down from a window in his palace and was surprised to see isaac caressing his wife rebekah.
target_text: isak dhu pea nèbhu le ètu nèi, hèia ca lod'o, dhèu aae nèdhi nèti ro'a jendela na, ladhe laa na isak dènge ribka dhu pa'ango.

source_text: so abimelech summoned isaac and said to him, now i realize that she is really your wife! so why did you say, ‘she is my sister'? isaac replied to him, i said that because i thought that someone here might kill me to get her.
target_text: ka na pua dhèu lasi paroa isak, hèia na peka, isak! ja'a dhu ke'a le, bhèni ne dhèu èmu èu! te ngaa tasamia ka, èu peka na, nèngu ne ana hèni èu? hèia isak dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e ama! ja'a ne madha'u, ladhe ja'a peka na nèngu ne dhèu èmu ja'a, mage dhoka dhèu pamadhe ja'a.

source_text: abimelech said, ◄you should not have done this to us! /why did you do this? ► rhq one of our people might have ◄had sex with/slept with► eup your wife, and you would have caused us to be guilty of a great sin!
target_text: ka dhèu aae dhaa, peka na, sèmi dhèu ètu se'e j'unu dènge dhèu èmu èu, tatu èu pasala ji'i! tasamia ka, èu ad'u j'ara ne'e mi dedha ji'i se?

source_text: then abimelech commanded all his people, saying, do not harm/molest this man or his wife! anyone who does that will surely be executed!
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae abimelek pasanèd'e ana kabarai na, aku nèngu na, miu nanene paie-iie! cee ka dhu bani gagu dhèu ne'e, do dhèu èmu na, èèna na ja'a huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: isaac planted grain in that land that year, and he harvested a very large crop, because yahweh blessed him.
target_text: tèu èèna, isak sèle hini ètu dedha rai dhèu se'e. lod'o d'ai puu-g'ètu, ka na abhu isi rai cangasu hari, lula lamatua hia ne mamèngi.

source_text: isaac continued to acquire more and more possessions, until finally he became very wealthy.
target_text: lula mèdha-panyau na asa ae, ka na kaja titu kèna.

source_text: he had large herds of sheep and goats and cattle, and many slaves. because of that, the philistine people envied him.
target_text: badha-manu na sèmi sapi, kahib'i-kalèbho asa tabha ae. dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, ae kahèi. nèti èèna ka, dhèu pilistin tèka d'ara dènge ne.

source_text: so all the wells that the servants of his father abraham had dug during the time when he was alive, the people filled up with dirt.
target_text: uru èèna, abraham, ama isak, dhu kèi èi ae-ae. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu pilistin dhènu eele aa'i si dènge rai.

source_text: then abimelech said to isaac, you people have become more numerous than we are, so i want you to get out of our area.
target_text: ka dhèu aae abimelek peka dènge isak, aku nèngu na, isak! be'a risi èu pakèd'i ka nèti kabarai ne'e. lula koasa èu, risi eele le nèti ji'i se.

source_text: so isaac and his family moved from there. they set up their tents in gerar valley and started to live there.
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak pakèd'i nèti era èèna, ka lasi pea hari ètu d'ara mamoo gerar.

source_text: there were several wells in that area that had been dug when isaac's father abraham was living, but philistine people had filled them up with dirt after abraham died. now isaac and his servants removed the dirt, and isaac gave the wells the same names that his father had given to them.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, ra kèi hari madha èi dhu uru èèna, dhèu pilistin dhènu eele aa'i si. ka na pangare madha èi se madhutu ngara dhu ama na pangare.

source_text: isaac's servants dug in the valley and discovered a well of fresh water.
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a isak se kèi èi ètu d'ara mamoo gerar, hèi lèke èi madha dhu sabhoka mai.

source_text: but other men who lived in gerar valley who took care of their animals argued/quarreled with the men who took care of isaac's animals, and said, the water in this well is ours! so isaac named the well esek, which means ‘dispute', because they disputed about who owned it.
target_text: lula madha èi ne'e ka, dhèu-dhèu madhenge badha nèti gerar, patao dènge dhèu madhenge badha isak. dhèu se peka na, ne'e ne, madha èi ji'i! nèti èèna ka, isak pangare madha èi na esek, dhu sasoa na ‘patao-palaha'.

source_text: then isaac's servants dug another well, but they quarreled about who owned that one also. so isaac named it sitnah, which means ‘opposition'.

source_text: they moved on from there and dug another well, but this time no one quarreled about who owned it. so isaac named it rehoboth, which means ‘uninhabited place', saying, yahweh has given us an uninhabited place to live in, a place that is not wanted by other people, and we will become very prosperous here.
